verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.06 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2019 (90% interval −0.10 to +0.04). Of 30 untouched cells given the same test, 3 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.13). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
